description.en: Native browser notification when DeepSeek Harness waits for a tool approval, an answer to a question, or a plan review. Subscribes to the client session status snapshot and changes nothing on the Host.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 等待工具审批、问题回答或计划复核时，发送浏览器原生通知。订阅客户端会话状态快照，不修改宿主。
